_readme: Rival strategies for the repeated border game. 'active' lists the rivals in play; 'strategies' holds each strategy's parameters. C = disarm (cooperate), D = build (defect).

alwaysDefect.label: Always builds
alwaysDefect.description: Builds arms every round, whatever you do.

titForTat.label: Tit-for-tat
titForTat.description: Disarms first, then copies your last move.

grudger.label: Grudger
grudger.description: Disarms until you build once, then builds forever.

forgiver.label: Forgiver
forgiver.description: Disarms unless you have built twice in a row.
